title: Ekiti State voter register — 2026 governorship election
methodology: Direct transcription of the INEC Chairman's 9 June 2026 Daily Bulletin statement on the Ekiti State Governorship Election register. Derived arithmetic is separately labelled and not attributed to INEC.
limitations: This is an Ekiti State election-specific register snapshot, not a nationwide voter register.

The bulletin reports 1,059,360 registered voters, a 2023 base register of 987,647 and 66,664 new registrants. Base plus new registrants equals 1,054,311, leaving a difference of 5,049 that is not explained in the bulletin.
The bulletin also reports 2,103 double registrations invalidated; the statement does not provide a full reconciliation of all additions, transfers, deletions and invalidations.
Do not add this figure to the 2023 national register or treat it as a current national total.
The statement describes a register for the 20 June 2026 governorship election; preserve its date and election context.
sourceQualityNote: Official INEC primary source, but its published register components do not reconcile arithmetically. The inconsistency is exposed rather than resolved by assumption.
